subject: history
concept: Applying government and civics knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student proposes a simple new rule or service for their own community and explains who would need to be involved
exercise.abstract: Student explains their proposal's reasoning in a short written response

assessment.mastery_threshold: proposal is connected to a real community need and identifies a plausible level of government/civic involvement
misconception_flags: proposal has no clear connection to any real community need or appropriate civic level

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
